title: Grateful Dead Live at Cameron Indoor Stadium, Duke U on 1973-12-08

ai_review.summary: A crystal‑clear soundboard capture of an excellent late‑'73 Dead show, praised as near‑perfect in both performance and audio quality.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about the recording’s pristine clarity—every instrument separates cleanly, vocals are natural and there’s virtually no tape hiss. The show itself is described as a solid late‑1973 performance that’s definitely worth listening to, even if it isn’t claimed to be the absolute best of the winter run.

ai_rating.rationale: Both reviews give 5‑star ratings and consistently praise both the performance and the flawless soundboard recording, indicating an outstanding show with excellent technical quality.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crystal‑clear mix, each instrument distinct, vocals not over‑processed, virtually no hiss or tape noise; overall a pristine recording.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Late ’73 show described as excellent and enjoyable throughout, with solid pacing and flow.
